coreProposition: Durable agent provenance should separate continuation-stable creation source from derivation lineage: ordinary resume must not silently relabel origin, while fork may establish a new local classification and retain its parent relation; neither label becomes authorization without an independent trust binding.

openingMove.purpose: Ask whether a week-old thread changes origin merely because a different client resumes it today.

argumentNodes.question: Why should resume preserve creation source?
argumentNodes.claim: Resume continues the same durable object, so caller-local defaults should not retroactively rewrite its origin classification.
argumentNodes.readerProgress: The reader identifies creation source as continuation-stable metadata.

argumentNodes.question: Why may fork set a different source?
argumentNodes.claim: Fork creates a new durable object, so it can carry its own local classification while parent lineage preserves derivation.
argumentNodes.readerProgress: The reader separates local role from where the derived object came from.

argumentNodes.question: What prevents provenance from becoming an unsafe principal?
argumentNodes.claim: Application-controlled source strings remain descriptive until independently bound to authenticated actor and policy evidence.
argumentNodes.readerProgress: The reader avoids using durable classification as authorization.

argumentNodes.question: How should compatibility and repair be represented?
argumentNodes.claim: A default inferred for missing historical metadata and a governed correction should remain distinguishable from directly observed creation provenance.
argumentNodes.readerProgress: The reader gains an operational metadata-scope and correction model.

counterpoint.claim: A coarse mutable source may be sufficient for telemetry, and administrative correction can be legitimate.
counterpoint.responseBoundary: Use the lighter model where appropriate, but record correction as a governed transition when the field supports audit or policy decisions.

endingStrategy.purpose: End by requiring every durable field to declare whether it is creation-scoped, continuation-stable, derivation-scoped or repairable.
